name: MFA / Users missing a passkey
text:
let passkey = dynamic(["passKeyDeviceBound", "passKeyDeviceBoundAuthenticator"]);
let app = dynamic(["microsoftAuthenticatorPush", "microsoftAuthenticatorPasswordless", "softwareOneTimePasscode"]);
reports_authenticationMethods_userRegistrationDetails
| extend
    hasHardwareKey = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, passkey)) > 0,
    hasAuthenticatorApp = array_length(set_intersect(methodsRegistered, app)) > 0,
    hasNoMFA = array_length(methodsRegistered) == 0
| extend PRFMA = iif(hasHardwareKey, "Passkey", iif(hasNoMFA, "No MFA", "Missing passkey"))
| where PRFMA <> "Passkey"
| project userDisplayName, userPrincipalName, PRFMA, hasAuthenticatorApp, defaultMfaMethod, methodsRegistered
| order by PRFMA asc, userDisplayName asc
